title: Async copy pipeline: cp.async multistage buffers

steps.title: Tuning: BK = 64, 64×64 warp tile, grouped rasterization

cases.name: tiny
cases.purpose: Only 1 K tile, fewer than the pipeline stages: the prologue must not read out of bounds, and empty commit groups must be counted correctly.

cases.name: short_k
cases.purpose: K = 72: 3 K tiles with BK = 32, 2 with BK = 64, and only 8 valid columns in the last one: checks the prologue, the pipeline tail and the wait_group count.

cases.name: aligned
cases.purpose: Exact multiple of the tile, 16 K tiles: the ring buffer wraps around several times, so a wrong stage index or missing sync reads stale data; exact comparison.

cases.name: tail
cases.purpose: M and N are odd and not multiples of the tile: out-of-bounds chunks must use the cp.async zero-fill, and the write-back must check bounds.

cases.name: raster
cases.purpose: 11 rows × 5 columns of CTA tiles: the last group of grouped rasterization (8 rows per group) has only 3 rows.

cases.name: random
cases.purpose: Medium-size random data; K is not a multiple of the tile.

cases.name: square
cases.purpose: Tensor Core throughput: 137 GFLOP, 64 MB of input.

cases.name: wide
cases.purpose: A and B total 128 MB, about the size of L2: the CTA execution order decides the L2 hit rate.
